ward_definition.reason_right_equals_left: Each jet is a polynomial in the same nilpotent generator G.

bridge_claim.exact_layer: The nilpotent closure action obeys exact finite Ward recursions: every higher jet is sourced by the previous jet through the same generator, and the recursion terminates when G kills the fifth jet.
bridge_claim.conditional_layer: Calling this a continuum Schwinger-Dyson equation requires a separate scaling limit; this verifier proves the finite operator identity.
